tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gong ma'i cho ga bzhugs/

na maḥshrī kā la tsakrā ya/ 'dir zab lam rdo rje rnal 'byor gyi 'khrid kyi sngon du nges par sgrub dgos pa/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pas/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par can bskyed par byed pa'i dbang bskur ba mchog dbang gong ma nyid bskur ba'i tshul ni/ bris sku la sogs pa'i mdun du mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis sam/ gtso bo'i zlum gtor gcig sde drug la zlum gtor ram zur gsum re re/ chos skyong dang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor sogs bshams/ bum pa dung chos gzungs thag rdo rje sogs kyang spyi dang mthun par 'cha'/ slob dpon gyi drung du nang mchod rdor dril cang te'u sogs tshogs par byas nas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma la chab btang*/ thog mar nang mchog la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa wa bhā wa shud+dho?&haṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+ra sogs/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra sūr+ya sogs dang*/ oṃ hūṃ badz+ra a na la sogs dang*/ oṃ hoḥsarba dharma sogs sngags tshan bzhis byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ pheṃ badz+ra ā' ral+li ho/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dṛ sh+ya ho/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa/ bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsa/ un man da/ a pa sma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki/ n+ya da ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gṛh+na tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya the baṃ/ ya theṣ+taṃ/ bhu dza thā/ dzi gha tha/ pi pa tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba karta ya/ sad su khaṃ bi shud+dha/ sā ha yi ka bha wān+tu/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsa na maḥ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ/ badz+ra dhu paṃ/ badz+ra dī paṃ/ badz+ra nai wi t+yaṃ/ badz+ra ak+ṣa taṃ/ badz+ra lā s+yaṃ/ badz+ra hā s+yaṃ/ badz+ra wā t+yaṃ/ badz+ra nṛ t+yaṃ/ badz+ra gi taṃ/

oṃ badz+ra kā ma pra tīts+tsha na maḥ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rim chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa bsnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro= /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung*/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro= /lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po= / 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang*/ /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ / srin po'i= /'byung po'i= /yi dwags= /sha za'i= /smyo byed= /brjed byed= / mkha' 'gro'i= /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*/ /de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma lus ji snyed mchis pa rnams/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grun kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ / gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan pa ngan/ / bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang*/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ / yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /gang dag dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams mchod pa dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la/

dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa'i bya ba la bar chad thams cad mi 'byung ba'i 'phrin las mdzod cig nag po'i phyogs la dga' ba dang*/ gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces pa'i mthar bdud bsregs pa'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad la/ mtshams rngams dang rol mo'i sgra drag po bya/ rdo rje'i rwa gur sa gzhi la sogs pa dang*/ me'i gur sogs yid kyi bsams te mtshams bcad pa'o// de nas gnas dang yo byad la/ rdo rje rtse mos nang mchod gtor/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ shel gyi snod sor bcu gnyis pa rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ aḥhuṃ hoḥrnams las byung ba'i chu dang*/ mchod mchod yon dang dri dang*/ me tog dang*/ bdug pa dang*/ snang gsal dang*/ zhal zas dam pa dag dang*/ rnam pa mang po'i 'bras bu ma nyams pa dang*/ gos dang*/ rgyan dang ba dan dang*/ bla bre la sogs pa dang*/ glu dang gar dang*/ me long dang*/ dril bu la sogs pa sil snyan gyi tshogs du ma dag dang*/ in+d+ra nī la la sogs pa rnam pa mang po'i rin po che dang*/ nang gi dam tshig rnams dang*/ dam tshig rnam pa bzhi'i rjes la sogs pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu dpag tu med cing dri ma dang bral bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ swāhā/ badz+ra puṣ+paṃ/ badz+ra dhu paṃ/ badz+ra dī paṃ/ badz+ra nai bi t+yaṃ/ badz+ra a k+ṣa taṃ/ badz+ra lā s+yaṃ/ badz+ra hā s+yaṃ/ badz+ra wā t+yaṃ/ badz+ra nṝ t+yaṃ/ badz+ra gī taṃ/ badz+ra ka maṃ swāhā/ rol chen dang bcas te/ oṃ hoḥbadz+ra gan+ṭe sarba dharmā e ka pradzñā dha ni/ swa bhā we/ sarba ā ka re/ sarba dharma pra bo dha ni/

sarba dharma ṇ-i swa bhā wān pra bo dha ya pra bo dha ya swāhā/ / zhes lan gsum brjod/ de dag ni sngon du bya ba'i rim pa yin no/ /da ni bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya ste/ spro zhing nus la shin tu rgyas pa spros pa la dga' ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bsgom par bya ba la 'bring du na/ thugs dkyil rgyas bsdus gang rung bsgom kyang shin tu legs par 'gyur zhing*/ bsdus pa la dga' bas lha bcu gsum dang lha dgu sogs ci rigs pa dang shin tu bsdus pa la dga' bas/ lhan skyes rgyas bsdus gang rung la brten nas kyang*/ mchog dbang gong ma bskur du rung la/ spyir dbang gong ma ni bskyed pa'i rim pa la mi ltos zhing*/ rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi cho ga'i spros pa gtso bor gyur pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ slob dpon de yan lag dang po'i rnal 'byor la brtan pa thob cing*/ bar pa bzhi'i rnal 'byor rjes mthun pa rnams su myong ba yan chad kyis/ bdag mdun gyi cho ga med par yang bskur bas chog pa kho na ste/ rgyu mtshan dbang gong ma rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gdod ma nas grub pa rnal 'byor pa'i ye shes kyi nyams su myong ba nyid 'di'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i cho ga yin gyi rtog pas sgom pa'i dkyil 'khor dang rdul tshon dang ras bris la sogs pa dbyibs su bkod pa'-i dkyil 'khor ni/ dbang gong ma rnams kyi dkyil 'khor ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ slob ma la byin rlabs 'jug pa yang de 'dra la ma ltos pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang de 'dra des bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi slad du de ltar byed pa yang mi 'gal lo/ /da lta'i dus kyi rdo rje'i slob dpon du grags pa/ grangs kyi bsnyen pa tsam la brten pa dang bskyed rim kho na la gnas pa dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi nyams myong cung zad skyes su chug kyang*/ yan lag dang po la brtan pa ma thob pa dang*/

de tsam thob kyang yan lag phyi ma rnams rjes mthun pa rgyud la ma skyes pa dag gis ni/ bdag bskyed dang phyi rol kyi mchod gtor nges par bya ste/ dbang gong ma'i yan lag tu dgos pa ma yin kyang*/ bdag nyid bsod nams spel zhing*/ lha'i byin rlabs slob ma la 'jug pa'i dgos pa chen po yod pas so/ /ci ste rjes dran gyi yan lag dngos thob pa yan chad kyi rnal 'byor pas ni bdag nyid ye shes kyi rnam rol la dbang 'byor ba yin pa'i phyir/ rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi cho ga'i yan lag phra mo la ma ltos te/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i spyod yul lo zhes rtogs par bya'o/ /des na skabs 'dir lha dgu'i bdag nyid can gyi sgrub thabs rgyas pa logs su bstan pa ltar/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas brtsams nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang gi thugs kar thim/ gyi bar rdzogs par bsgoms te bdag bskyed do/ /de nas bum pa sgrub pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ haṃ hāṃ hiṃ hīṃ huṃ hūṃ hl̥ṃ hl̥̄ṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su khu ba dang rdul 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ shar dang mer rkang 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ lho dang bden bral du khrag 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ byang dang dbang ldan du gci ba 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis dang*/ nub dang rlung du bshang ba 'gags pa'i bum pa gnyis te/ bdud rtsi'i bum pa dkar po pad+ma la gnas shing pad+mas kha brgyan pa rnams su gyur/ rang gi snying gar zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan gyi steng du/ hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las/ dus kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs yum dang bcas par gsal ba'i/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba dang*/ yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor te/ de dag kha sbyar ba las rdo rje lcags kyu dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba spros nas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i bum pa rnams dang ro gcig tu gyur/ oṃ haṃ hāṃ hiṃ hīṃ hūṃ hūṃ hl̥ṃ hl̥̄ṃ badz+ra pad+ma a mṛ ta gha ṭa su bi shud+dha dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa sarba d+dharmān su bi shud+dha dhārmā dha tu swa bhā wān ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes mang du bzlas/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ nas/ kā maṃ pra tits+tsha na maḥ zhes pa'i bar mchod pa bcu gnyis phul/ de dag ni bum pa sgrub pa'i cho ga'o/ /'di la 'og tu slob ma la khyor chu sbyin pa tsam las/ dgos don gzhan med pa'i phyir/ bum pa sgrub pa 'di mtha' cig tu dgos pa min pa ltar snang yang rdo rje 'chang dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis phyag len yin pas phyir/ nan tan du bya ba kho na'o/ /de nas mchod gtor 'bul ba ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa yongs su gyur pa las/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhuṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ zhes lan mang du brjod cing*/ dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba rang gi blo dang mtshams par yid kyis gsal btab bo/ /spro na bstod chen gyi tshig ji ltar 'os pa/ 'don pa sogs mngon rtogs rgyas bsdus gang rung dang mthun par ngag nas brjod kyang legs/ 'on kyang yid kyi bsams pa tsam gyis chog cing gtso bo yab yum kho na sgoms pas kyang rung ngo*/ /de nas mgron spyan drangs shing mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad mchod pa'i yul du badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa/ nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ trai dhā tu ke shwa ra kā la tsakra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha sa pa ri wā rāḥtwaṃ bha ga wān me wa ra do bha wa shi ṣ+ya nāñtsa/

zhes pa lan gsum/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ pad+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ de bzhin du sbyar te/ añtsa ma naṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ pro k+ṣa naṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ khams gsum dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das/ /dus kyi 'khor lo 'khor bcas rnams/ /rnam dag rdo rje'i dri mchog 'di/ /bzhes nas bdag la mchog stsol mdzod/ /oṃ shrī kā la tsakra sa pā ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes kun la sbyar te/ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rkang pa gsum snga ma bzhin kun la sbyar te/ rdo rje me tog rnam bkra'i tshogs/ /badz+ra puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje bdug spos bla na med/ /badz+ra dhu paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje sgron me 'od rab 'bar/ /badz+ra dī paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje zhal zas ro mchog ldan/ /badz+ra ne wi t+ye pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje ma nyams 'bras bu'i mchog / badz+ra ak+ṣa taṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje sgegs mo'i mchod pa ni/ /badz+ra lā s+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje bzhad ma'i mchod pa ni/ /badz+ra hā s+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje sil snyan rnam mang po/ /badz+ra bā t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje gar gyi mchod sprin 'di/ /badz+ra nṛ t+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje glu dbyangs yid 'phrog ldan/ /badz+ra gī taṃ tīts+tsha na maḥ rdo rje 'dod ma'i mchod pa mchog /badz+ra kā maṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ nang mchod ni gong ltar byin gyis brlabs/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun thams cad kyi ngo bo/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag po/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi skyob pa drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang 'di zhes bya ba'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dngos grub rgya mtsho yon tan rin chen gter/ /srid dang zhi ba'i gdung ba sel ba'i sman/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang la mchod par 'bul/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ nyi ma'i 'od dang zla bzang lha dbang dang*/ /gzi brjid zlas sbyin lha'i dbang phyug dang*/

/sna tshogs gzugs dang lha yi dbang ldan te/ /chos rgyal chen po brgyad la mchod par 'bul= 'jam dbyangs grags pa pad+ma dkar po dang*// bzang po rnam rgyal bshes gnyen bzang po dang*/ /phyag na rin chen khyab 'jug sbas pa dang*/ /nyi ma grags dang shin tu bzang po mchod= rgya mtsho rnam rgyal rgyal dka' nyi ma dang*/ /sna tshogs gzugs dang zla 'od mtha' yas dang*/ /sa skyong dpal skyong seng ge rnam gnon dang*/ /stobs chen ma 'gags mi yi seng ge mchod= dbang phyug chen po mtha' yas rnam rgyal dang*/ /drag po zhes bya nyi shu rtsa lnga po/ /sa'i 'khor lo rdzogs par skyong ba ste/ /tshangs pa lha dbang phyed phyed skyod rnams mchod= 'od srung la sogs dum bu skyong ba brgyad/ /de ltar sa skyong sum cu rtsa lnga ni/ /rigs kun gcig tu mdzad pa gsang sngags kyi/ /rigs ldan brgyud pa rnams la mchod par 'bul= dus zhabs gnyis dang nā len+d+ra pa dang*/ / zla ba mgon po 'bro ston lo tsā dang*/ /lha rje sgom pa sgro ston gnam brtsegs dang*/ /grub chen yu mo rnams la mchod pa 'bul= chos kyi dbang phyug nam mkha' 'od zer dang*/ /sprul sku jo 'bum grub thob se chen dang*/ /chos rje 'jam gsar chos sku 'od zer dang*/ /kun spangs chos rje rnams la mchod par 'bul= byang sems chen po yon tan rgya mtsho dang*/ /kun mkhyen chos rje sgra bsgyur sku mched dang*/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal nya dpon chos rje dang*/ /grub chen kun blo rnams la mchod par 'bul= 'jam dbyangs dkon bzang nam mkha'i mtshan can gnyis/ /nam mkha' dpal bzang rat+na bha dra dang*/ /grol mchog zhabs dang lung rigs rgya mtsho dang*/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen te/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mngon sum ston mdzad pa'i/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchog par 'bul/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/

phyis kyang mjug gi tshig rnams rim pas 'don pa bsgyur bar bya'o/ / oṃ kā la tsakra ya hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ bi shwa mā ta ho phraiṃ swāhā/ oṃ a ā aṃ aḥ ha hāṃ haṃ haḥswāhā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ a ā i ī ṛ ṝ u ū l̥ l̥̄/ ha hā hi hī hu hū hl̥ hl̥̄ haṃ haḥ a ā e ai ar ār o au al āl/ ha hā ya yā ra rā wa wā la lā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor la 'bul/ bar 'dir sgos kyi chos skyong la'ang phul/ thams cad kyi mthar/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa bh+yo na mo na maḥ gzhan yang rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad la mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bka' sdod chos skyong bsrung ma thams cad la mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yul bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad la mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la 'bul lo/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba'i rgyud tshims nas/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar gyur cig de nas bstod pa ni/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid snying po khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas bzhad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /med pa las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud/ / thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/

/ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ / ces 'dud nyi shus bstod/ spro zhing nus na/ gang la thog mtha' dbus med gnas dang 'chi dang srid pa dang ni sgra dang dri dang ro dag dang*/ /reg bya gzugs dang sems med rang bzhin dang ni skyes bu med cing 'ching dang grol dang byed po med/ /sa bon dang ni gsal bar dus med mtha' dag srid par sdug bsngal bde ba nyid kyi rang bzhin med/ /mya ngan 'das pa mtshan ma med cing byed pa rnams bral yon tan med pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus dang sna tshogs la sogs rdo rje dang ni skyes bu dpe med kun 'gro spros pa med pa ste/ /ther zug tu gnas snyan dang shangs dang zhal dang spyan dang dbu dang phyag dang zhabs ni thams cad pa/ / 'byung po'i mtha' te 'byung po'i mgon po mchog gi srid pa gsum 'dzin rgyu rnams dag gi rgyur gyur pa/ /rig pa la sogs rnal 'byor dag gis rtog bya mchog bde'i go 'phang dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal/ /spro byed nus ma'i gzugs gzhan glog gi me dang mtshungs shing nyi ma bcu gnyis dag gi gzi brjid can/ /ye shes rdo rje'i snang ba mchog gi go 'phang bgrod byed rnam par bcad pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkar po 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po ri bong 'dzin pa las 'dzag 'jig rten spyi bor yang dag gnas/ /bdud rtsi 'chi ba sel zhing srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms par byed pa thig le'i gzugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems tsam sngags kyi ngo bo lha yis yongs su bskor ba sdug bsngal dang ni bde ba'i rang bzhin te/ /dam pa rnams la zhi ba'i gzugs ni rang gis byas pa'i nyams myong mi bzad rnams la mi bzad pa/ /gang gis las gang rab byas rang gi sems la cho ga bzhin du de yi 'bras bus de bskyed pa/ /'jig rten dbang po sna tshogs gzugs can srid gsum bskyed mdzad rdo rje sems dpa' la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /gcig dang du ma dag kyang gcig cing mnyam dang mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab dang*/

/steng 'og kun nas dkar ljang sna tshogs kha dog chen po gcig gi gzugs te thung ngu ring po dang*/ / shin tu ring po yon tan med ces yon tan dang bcas bud med skyes pa'am skyes pa bud med min/ /gang zhig kun gyi brten gcig bha ga bzang mo mchog gi bha ga khyod la 'dud de khyod la 'dud/ / ces pas kyang bstod do/ / oṃ dzñā na pū dza a nu rak+to swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes rjes chags kyis mchod cing nga rgyal bzung de nas lha dgu'i sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs nas brtsams/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / gi bar gyi 'phrin las bcol ba yan chad gtor chog ltar gtor ma 'bul/ 'byung po spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs kyang btang*/ steng na byang chub sems dpa' gang dag ces sogs shis brjod bya/ mchod gtor gyi rim pa'o/ /de nas spro zhing lcogs na bla ma rnams kyi phyag len la mdzad pa ltar/ tshogs rdzogs pa'i don du sngon 'gro'i maṇ+ḍal nas brtsams te/ mchog dbang mtha' dag bdag 'jug gi tshul du rdzogs par blangs na shin tu legs shing*/ spyir slob dpon gyis bdag 'jug ma blangs kyang*/ slob ma dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'i yan lag nyams par 'gyur ba ni ma yin no/ /de dag gi skabs 'di la ltos pa'i slob dpon gyi bya ba rgyas pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol lam/ yol khang gi phyi rol tu mngon du phyogs pa la sbyang ba ni/ bgegs gtor rnams bshams/ bsangs sbyangs 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma'am mtheb skyu gsum po rim gyis bskor la/ oṃ sarba bigh+nāṃ bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud ga te s+pha na ṇa i maṃ ga ga ṇa khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ te swāhā/ zhes lan gsum/ 'dir slob ma rnams la dbang gi ye shes skye ba la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad/

mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim nas/ phan pa dang bde ba'i sems dang ldan pas gzhan du dengs shig zhi bas sbyang ba'o/ / oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bir+ya rā dza huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum bzlas shing rdo rje gsor la/ ting lo'am chang bu bskor/ 'dir slob ma 'di rnams la dbang gi ye shes bskyed pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa de thams cad/ gtor ma lam brngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces pa ni zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba'o/ /hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas nas bden stobs brjod la/ mthar drag po'i mtshams rngams rol chen dang bcas pas bskrad pa ni/ 'di ltar/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa dang*/ kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis 'dir slob ma 'di rnams la dbang gi ye shes bskyed pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag deng dpal rdo rje shugs kyi bka' thos pas/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par myur ba nyid du song shig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag thams cad dus gsum gyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o/

/ bsdu na de tsam mam shin tu spros pa la dga' na phyag rgya dang mtshon cha dgod pa sogs byas nas/ bstod dbyangs rgyas pa sngon du 'gro bas byas kyang rung la spros pa 'bring tsam dbang du byas na/ rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs dang*/ rje bo sna tshogs sogs dang*/ nga ni sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /nga ni khro rgyal he ru ka /nga ni dpal ldan dus 'khor lo/ /nga yi bka' las ma 'da' zhig /lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon/ /nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje shugs/ /bka' yi 'khol lo rab sbyor bar/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ / lus gsum las skyes dgas par bya/ /gal stai kha cig bdag tshig 'da'/ / 'dir ni 'jig 'gyur gzhan du min/ /rdo rje'i rwa gur rab tu brtan/ /rdo rje khro bo'i sprin spros nas/ /mtshon cha yig 'bru me dpung 'bar/ /bar mtshams med par mtshams bcad do/ / zhes nyungs dkar gtor gu gul la sogs kyi dud pas bdug rol mo'i sgra sgrogs te/ bgegs bskrad cing gtor ma phyi rol tu dor te/ drag pos sbyang ba'o/ /bsdus pa la mos na/ bka' bsgo ba yid kyis byas nas sngags tsam brjod do/ / bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad snying gar yi ge baṃ gyi rnam par gnas pa lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis ded de/ sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa mdun gyi til lam yungs dkar la thim/ bsangs sbyangs/ 'bar ba'i me nang du khro bo rdo rje mkha' 'gro rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa zhal gdangs pa'o/ / oṃ badz+ra ḍā gi kha kha kh+hī kh+hī/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmi ku ru swāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ las kyi rdo rjes til lam yungs dkar g.yas g.yon du bskor nas/ g.yas su me dag g.yon tu chur dor bas/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal du gsol ba dang*/ rgya mtsho chen por bsgyur bar bsam/ mthar me yang chu nang du ldug go

/sdig pa sbyang ba'o/ /skabs 'dir spros pa la dga' na drug bzhi ldan gyi sgo nas phyur bsal bar mdzad pa'i phyag len yang gda' ste mi 'gal lo/ /de nas 'di skad ces/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgo bor ū yig dang*/ snying gar ī yig dang*/ gtsug tor tu ā yig ste/ thabs kyi rigs gsum dang*/ lte ba lā yig dang*/ mgrin par rā yig dang*/ gsang bar āḥyig ste shes rab kyi rang bzhin yi ge gsum gyis bsrungs shing rgyas btab par mos shig de nas sems bskyed gsal 'debs pa dang chos spyi 'gro'i bshad pa cung zad byas nas/ 'dir rdzogs rim thams cad kyi mthar thug zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgom pa la sngar ma smin na smin byed kyi dbang dgos la/ sngar smin yang ye shes ma skyed pa bskyed pa'i phyir du/ skabs 'dir nges par dbang gong ma rnams bskur dgos shing*/ gang zag dbang po dman pa la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gang yang rung bar/ thun mong gi smin byed byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun thob na legs mod/ yang gsang 'dus bde mchog dgyes rdor sogs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ bsdus rgyud phal cig gi rjes su 'brangs te/ 'phags yul gyi paṇa grub phal cher la grags pa'i/ cho ga rnam dag gcig gi steng nas bum dbang du grags pa de thob na yang*/ byis 'jug dang don gyi gnad gcig pa'i legs te/ go rim ma 'chol zhing*/ spyir btang gi bshad pa'i rim pa dang mthun/ dbang po dman pa rnams la de ltar 'thad cha shas che/ 'on kyang dbang po rnon po rnams dang*/ dbang brtul la yang bsam pa dang dgos pa'i khyad par gyi dmigs bsal la byis 'jug gi dbang ngam/ de'i dod sngon du ma song bar yang*/ mchog dbang bskur du mi rung ba ma yin te/ dbang bskur ba ni sdom pa 'bog pa'i cho ga yin la/ sdom pa 'bogs yul la 'bogs chog byed pa/ gsang sgrogs su 'gyur ba'i go skabs nam yang yod pa ma yin zhing*/

'on kyang go rim brgal ba'i skyon yod snyam na de yang spyir btang dmigs gsal gyi khyad yin te/ dge bsnyen la sogs pa'i sdom pa sngon du ma song bar snyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa skye ba bzhin yin pa'i phy-ir ro// 'dir skabs slob ma rnams sngar dbang ji ltar rigs pa thob ma thob dang brtun nas/ de dang mthun pa'i brda' sprod bya/ sngon 'gro'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes brjod la/ slob ma'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ mi zad 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa bdag ni de ring nyid nas rgyal ba rnams la skyabs su lhag par mchi/ khyed kyi zhabs kyi chu skyes nges par srid pa'i 'jigs 'phrog dag la lus ngag sems ni dag pas so/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ sdom pa bzung ba 'di'i rjes zlos byar gzhug te/ 'dod pa'i rdo rje la ni rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya bla ma dag kyang spyi bos bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen la ni sbyin pa sbyin bgyi 'khor lo 'di la rgyal ba mchog gi dam tshig bskyang bar bgyi// ral gri la ni mchod pa bgyi ste gsal bar chu skyes rigs la sdom pa rnams ni bskyod pa bgyi/ /sems can rnams ni thar pa'i slad du rgyal ba bskyed mdzad rigs la byang chub bdag gis bskyang bar bgyi/ / zhes lan gsum mo/ /bsdus pa la mos na sngon 'gro de tsam gyis chog la/ 'bring po la mos na/ de rjes slob ma'i gnas drug tu dri bzang gi thig le dngos su byed pa'am byas par mos la/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ lte bar hoḥ gtsug tor tu haṃ/ gsang bar k+ṣaḥrnams su gyur/ ces brjod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes nang mchod nas slob ma'i lus la bdud rtsi gtor la srung bar byas par mos/ de nas cung zad spro na bum chu nas bsres pa'i dri bzang gi chu blud la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ dam tshig bsrung ba dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/

/oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta u ta ka ṭha ṭha hūṃ/ zhes brjod/ bla ma dang dus kyi 'khor lo gnyis su med pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpa' mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ de'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ khyod rang rnams kyi lus la thim pas/ lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis brlab par mos pa gyis shig rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ oṃ a ā aṃ aḥbadz+ra satwa mahā su kha badz+ra kā la tsakra shi ṣu s+ya a bhi mu khot+bha wa san+tuṣ+to bha wa ba ra do bha ba/ kā ya bāka tsit+ta a dhiṣ+ṭha naṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes mang du bzlas te rdo rje sems dpa' bskul ba'o/ /cung zad spros pa la dga' na rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs nyer lnga sbyin par yang bzhed de mi 'gal lo/ /de nas bum chu dung chos kyis blangs nas/ oṃ haṃ ha sogs bum pa'i sa bon rnams lan mang du brjod la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ / lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ a i ṛ u l̥ pañtsa dha du bi shwa dha ni swāhā/

zhes pas khrus gsol zhing 'thung du gzhug go /'di skabs phyag len lugs gcig la slob ma sta gon gyi khyor chu'i sngags kyis sbyin par mdzad pa'ang yod mod kyi/ bum sgrub dang 'brel ba'i phyir 'di nyid legs so// sngon 'gro shin tu spros pa la mos na/ lo tsā ba blo gros dpal gyis mdzad pa'i gong ma'i dbang mchog bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas su bshad pa ltar/ slob ma sta gon gyi chos thun mong ma yin pa rnams dang*/ phyi dkyil gyi 'jug pa'i cho ga rags pa rnams sbyor ba'i lugs kyang yod pa/ dbang gong ma'i yan lag tu ni mi dgos mod/ slob ma'i mos pa dang bstun nas byed pa yang mi 'gal lo/ /dngos gzhi'i thog mar 'di skad ces bya ste/ de yang rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rdo rje'i thig ni gdab pa dang*/ /tshon rtsi dag ni dgye ba dag /sngags kyi de nyid kyis mi bya/ /byas na byang chub rnyed par dka'/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dbang gong ma rnams ni rdul tshon la sogs pa phyi dbyibs bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor du bskur ba ma yin la/ chu dbang la sogs pa bum dbang du bshad pa yang*/ de ltar ming btags pa tsam ste dbang bzhi'i nang tshan gyi bum dbang ma yin pa dang*/ dbang bzhi ni gong ma kho na las phye ba yin par mthar thug gi rgyud sde rnams las gsungs pa yin zhing*/ des na phyag rgya'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bum dbang*/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang*/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes 'jig rten pa'i dbang*/ don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du bzhi pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang rnams bskur ba yin pas/ de ltar go dgos shing dbang bskur ba po ni thams cad la rdo rje slob dpon te/ de yang bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo'i g.yas zhal sku rdo rje la bum dbang*/ g.yon zhal gsung rdo rje la gsang dbang*/ mdun zhal thugs rdo rje la sher dbang*/ rgyab zhal ye shes rdo rje la bzhi pa rnams zhu ba'i bsam pa bskyed dgos/

de la thog mar mchog dbang bzhi po spyi khyab kyi don du/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rigs kyi phyag rgya dang*/ zhing khams rnam par dag pa rin po ches phyur bur bkang bar mos la/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes brjod cing slob mas kyang*/ maṇ+ḍal phul te/ sgrib pa thams cad bcom pa yi/ /dus kyi 'khor lo khyod la 'dud/ /mchog tu mi 'gyur bdes gang ba/ /ye shes sku khyod la phyag 'tshal// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /byang chub sems ni 'gyur med bde/ /dbang bskur de yis bdag la ni/ /mgon pos da ni bka' drin mdzod/ /bu dang chung ma sogs byas pa/ /bdag ni dus kun khyod kyi 'bangs/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i mthar/ /bdag la skyabs gzhan yod ma yin/ / zhes pas thun mong du gsol ba btab/ de nas bum dbang nyid kyi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ lus la sku rdo rje byin rlabs 'jug pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dpal ldan sku yi rdo rje 'dzin// mi phyed rdo rje gsum bsgoms pas/ /sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ / mi phyed rdo rje gsum sgoms pas/ /sku yi rdo rje can gyis ni/ /byin rlabs gnas su deng bdag mdzod/ / ces lan gsum gsol ba btab/ slar yang bum dbang dngos gzhi'i don du gsol ba lan gsum 'debs pa ni/ oṃ oṃ pradzñā u pa au ka la sha a bhi ṣe kaṃ me da dā tāṃ hu hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'o/ / bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa thams cad kyi dpral ba'i oṃ yig dkar po las/ oṃ yig 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dpag tu med pa byon nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bas/ lus kyi dri ma dag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/

byas la/ rol chen bya zhing*/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis slob ma 'di'i lus kyi thig le dang*/ sad pa'i gnas skabs 'gags shing*/ dga' ba'i dga' ba rdzogs nas/ sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku sgyu 'phrul drwa bas mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces slob ma'i ched du sangs rgyas rnams la bla mas gsol ba gdab bo/ /de ni bum dbang gi byin rlabs dbab pa'o/ /de nas bum dbang dngos ni/ sngar phul ba'i phyag rgya de nyid sna tshogs yum du byin gyis brlabs nas/ lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ma/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /zung zhig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ /zung la mchod pa dag tu gyis/ / zhes rig ma gtad/ de'i nub ma la lag pas reg pas de las byung ba'i bde ba nyams su myong ba de 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi dga' ba'i dga' ba ste/ de nyid bum pa'i dbang gi don no/ /de ltar na phyag rgya'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ sngags kyi tshul la dge tshul du gyur zhing*/ sa brgyad pa mi g.yo bar lung bstan pa thob pa sangs rgyas kyi sras su gyur pa yin no/ / zhes brda sprad/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra satwa na badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣe ke ṇa a bhi ṣe k+to badz+ra satwa pu tro a tsa lā bhū mi lab+dho haṃ/ zhes rjes zlos byed du bcug pas nga rgyal bzung bar bya ste bum pa'i dbang ngo*/ / de nas gsang dbang gi don du man+ṭal 'bul/ ngag la gsung rdo rje'i byin brlabs gzhugs pa'i don du/ gong gi tshigs bcad la/ dpal ldan gsung gi rdo rje 'dzin/ / zhes 'don pa spos te lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ gsang dbang dngos gzhi'i don du/ oṃ āḥpradzñā u pa yo gu h+ya a bhi ṣe kaṃ me da dā tāṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas gsol pa gdab/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa thams cad kyi/

mgrin pa'i āḥyig dmar po las/ āḥyig 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba dpag tu med pa byon te/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bas ngag gi dri ma dag sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ rol chen bya/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis slob ma 'di'i ngag gi thig le dang*/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs 'gags shing*/ mchog dga'i dga' ba rdzogs nas/ gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rnam pa nyi shus mngon par rdzogs pa byang chub thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces bla mas brjod de gsang dbang gi byin rlabs 'bebs pa'o/ /de nas gsang dbang dngos ni/ oṃ dwā da sha aṃ ga ni ro dha ka ri ṇe hūṃ phaṭa/ gdong g.yog bcings par bsam pa'am dngos su bcings/ de nas/ bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa spyan drangs nas sku la zhugs pa/ chags pa chen pos zhu bar gyur/ a wa dhū tī'i lam nas brgyud de nor bur byon pa'i bdud rtsi mthe bong dang ming med kyis bzung nas lce thog tu bzhag par gyur/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur*/ /byang chub sems ni bzang po yis/ /de ltar bu khyod dbang bskur bgyi/ / zhes dang*/ bla med de ni 'di nyid de/ / gnyis su med cing mi 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi dbyings ni dam pa yi/ /yang dag bde ba myang bar gyis/ / zhes brjod pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsam te/ a ho mahā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod*/ dngos su bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba'i nang mchod kyi thigs pa lan gnyis su lce la bzhag cing btung bar bya'o// mi dar bsal / oṃ de byen dra ya ṇ+yu ḍa ghā ṭa ya swāhā/ phyag rgya'i bha ga gsal bar byas pa yang bltas te/ de las byung bas bde ba nyams su myong ba 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi mchog dga'i dga' ba ste/

de nyid gsang ba'i dbang don no/ /de ltar na phyag rgya'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ sngags kyi tshul la dge slong du gyur zhing*/ sa dgu pa legs pa'i blo gros su lung bstan pa thob pa sangs rgyas kyi rgyal tshab tu gyur pa yin no/ / zhes brda' sprad la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra satwe na gu h+ya a bhi ṣe ke ṇa a bhi ṣi k+to badz+ra satwa/ yu ba rā dzo na wa bhu mi lab+dho haṃ/ zhes rjes zlos byed du bcug pas nga rgyal bzung bar bya ste/ gsang ba'i dbang ngo*/ /de nas/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ yid la thugs rdo rje'i byin brlabs 'jug pa'i don du/ dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin/ / zhes gong gi tshigs bcad la 'don pa spos te gsol ba gdab/ shes rab ye shes dngos gzhi'i don du/ oṃ hūṃ pradzñā u pa yau badz+ra satwa bi shwa mā ta ro/ pradzñā dzñā ne a bhi ṣe kaṃ me da dā tāṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas gsol ba btab/ de nas bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer zhes sogs/ byin rlabs dbab pa snga ma rnams kyis rigs 'gre ba las/ thugs ka'i hūṃ yig sngon po las/ hūṃ yig 'od zer sngon po 'phro ba/ snying ga nas zhugs yid kyi dri ma dag thugs rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs/ zhes dang*/ yid kyi thig le dang*/ gnyid 'thug gi gnas skabs 'gags/ khyad dga'i dga' ba rdzogs/ thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku rnam pa lngas mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa/ zhes kyang 'don pa spo'o/ /de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dngos ni/ bla mas sngar phul ba'i rig ma de slob ma la gtad par mos la/ 'dir ni khyed rnams dpang po lags/ /bdag gis 'di la 'di gtad do/ /zhes rdo rje sems dpa' dpang por byas nas/ gzung ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyi/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags/ /'khor lo'i rim pa'i sbyor ba yi/ /bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis/ /rdo rje skyil krung gis sems

ni/ /nor bu'i nang du gnas blta bas/ / zhes go bar byas/ phyag rgya sna tshogs yum du byas pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūṃ/ lte bar hoḥ gsang bar swā/ gtsug tor du hā rnams 'khod par gyur/ phyag rgya des kyang chu skyes gur gum la sogs pa'i dri bzang por byas pa ston cing*/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig cho gas bsten byed pa// de yi mdun na bdag gnas te/ /sangs rgyas bsten pa la sogs pa/ /pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin gyis/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu gnas/ /bhañdza mo k+ṣa hoḥ bdag nyid dus kyi 'khor lo gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūṃ/ lte bar hoḥ gsang bar swā/ gtsug tor tu hā rnams 'khod par gyur/ shes rab kyi pad+ma āḥlas pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rjes mtshan pa/ thabs kyi rdo rje huṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ dbus su āḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pas mtshan par gyur/ lag bcangs dang gnyis sbyor gyi sgo nas snyoms par zhugs/ oṃ dzñā na pū dza a nu rak+to swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de lta bu'i sbyor ba las byung ba'i bde ba nyams su myong bar gyur pa ni/ 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi dga' bral gyi dga' ba dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ste/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don no/ /de rnams ni dga' ba bzhi'i dbye bas/ kun rdzob kyi dbang rnam pa bzhi'o/ /de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor tu shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas/ sngags kyi tshul la gnas brtan tu gyur zhing*/ sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin la gnas par lung bstan pa thob pa rdo rje 'chang gnyis par gyur pa yin no/ / zhes brda sprad la/ oṃ hūṃ badz+ra satwa na/ pradzñā dzñā ne na a bhi ṣe ke na a bhi ṣi k+to dwī dī yo/ badz+ra dha ro3haṃ dharma me gha mi lab+dho3haṃ/

zhes rjes zlos byed du bcug pa'i nga rgyal bzung bar bya ste/ gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dngos so/ de nas bla mas/ dam tshig gi nges pa sbyin pa ni/ 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba de ni don dam pa ma yin gyi/ don dam par rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi bde ba ni thig le 'pho ba med pa yin pas bde ba chen po'i rten thig le ni khyod kyis bsrung bar bya'o/ / zhes bya ba ni/ las kyis phyag rgya'i rab sbyor dang*/ /ye shes phyag rgya'i rjes chags la'ang*/ /bde ba chen po byang chub sems/ /brtul zhugs brtan pos bsrung bar bya/ /bha gar ling ga rab bzhag nas/ /byang chub sems ni spro mi bya/ khams gsum po ni ma lus pa'i/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni bsgom par bya/ /srung ba 'di nyid kho na yis/ /skye ba 'di la sangs rgyas nyid/ / tshul khrims tshogs ni yang dag rdzogs/ /bsod nams ye shes yang dag ldan/ / pha rol phyin bcu thob pa yi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dus gsum 'jug / 'di yis rdzogs sangs rgyas kun gyi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /rang dang gzhan don sgrub pa'i slad/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ /khams gsum dbang phyug ye shes ni/ /'di las gzhan pa yod ma yin/ /skyob pa kun gyi sdom pa ni/ /gal te khyod srung bdag gi bu/ /de tshe sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ / byin rlabs rdzogs byang chub thob 'gyur/ /ci ste chags pas zin mnan bdag / gtso bo'i mdun du blangs nas ni/ /sdom pa skyong bar mi byed na/ /de tshe ngu 'bod du 'gror 'gyur/ /dman pa'i sems las skye gnas su/ /gang tshe byang chub sems ltung 'gyur/ /de tshe phyag rgyar shes nas ni/ /pad+ma'i phyi rol rang lces blangs/ / zhes brjod par bya ste/ sdom pa sbyin pa'i nges pa'o/ /spros pa la dga' na skabs 'dir/ gal te g.yo sgyu'i dbang gis zhes sogs rtsa ltung bcu bzhi ston pa'i rgyud tshig rnams brjod nas don yang bshad do/

/slar yang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la dbang bskur ba'i rab tu byed pa'i bka' drin gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes pas gsol ba gdab bo/ / de nas bla ma'i bu khyod nyon cig kun rdzob ji lta ba bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi thun mong gi bde ba/ dga' ba bcu drug gi mtshan nyid ni/ 'dod pa spyod par byed pas 'gro ba rang gi yid la'o gang ba dag ni gang ba nyid du 'gyur// gang ba yan lag mchog la ri bong 'dzin pa khu bar byas nas 'bar ba'i thig le bzang po 'dzag /oṭ+ṭas bkug pa mchog gi bde ba rang bzhin gyis ster thig le grol ba dag ni gsum gyi mthar/ /blta dang reg dang 'grogs las 'dzag pa'i bde ba 'di dag gis ni dga' ba la sogs dbye bas te/ /'dod pa dga' ba byed de dang po dag kyang mi rnams kyis ni mig gis blta ba rnams kyis so/ / phyi nas gang bas rab tu sbyar ba yis te slar yang mchog gi dga' ba nyid de rang lus la/ /'bar ba nyid la thig le 'dzag pa'i dga' ba yis kyang khyad par dga' ba rdo rje pad+ma la/ /oṭ+ṭa thig le gsum gyi mtha' ru 'gyur pa la gnas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba rdo rje byed/ /ces dga' ba bzhi dang de dag re re la yang*/ lus dang ngag dang sems dang*/ ye shes kyi dbye bas phye ba dga' ba bcu drug tu 'gyur ba ji lta ba bzhin du/ chags bral dang po chags pa che/ kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od/ /rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i gnas/ /sangs rgyas brjod pa'i chos 'dzin pa/ /

zhes dang*/ rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med/ /bcu drug phyed phyed thig le 'chang*/ /cha med cha las 'das pa po/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo 'chang*/ /zhes thig le 'pho ba med pa don dam pa'i dga' ba bzhi yang sku gsung thugs ye shes kyi dbye bas phye ba ni de kho na nyid bcu drug yin la/ 'jig rten kun rdzob pa'i shes rab ye shes ni mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes tsam ste/ don dam pa ma yin gyi des nye bar mtshon pa 'jig rten las 'das pa dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes ni don gyi ye shes te/ de kho na nyid kyi don yin no/ /zhes 'pho ba med pa'i don dam pa spros pa dang bral zhing stong pa nyid dang snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes la 'dun par bya ste/ de yan chad dbang gong ma chung ngu zhes bya ste 'jig rten pa'i dbang gsum pa'i cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa'o/ /de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang bzhi pa zhi ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ ye shes la ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs gzhug pa'i don du/ dpal ldan ye shes rdo rje 'dzin/ /mi phyed rdo rje bzhi bsgoms pas/ / zhes pa dang*/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /mi phyed rdo rje bzhi bsgoms pas/ / zhes gong gi tshigs bcad la 'don pa spos te gsol ba btab/ dbang bzhi pa dngos gzhi'i don du/ oṃ hoḥpradzñā a pā yau/ āt+ma kaṃ badz+ra satwa mahā mu dra dzñā na a bhī ṣe kaṃ me pra yats+tsha/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥphaṭa/ ces pas gsol ba btab/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i sogs/ byin rlabs dbab pa snga ma rnams kyis rigs 'gre ba las/ lte ba'i hoḥyig 'od zer ser po 'phro ba/ lte ba nas zhugs/ chags rtogs gi dri ma zhes dang*/ ye shes kyi thig le dang bzhi pa'i gnas skabs lhan skyes kyi dga' ba/ ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid kyi sku sgyu 'phrul drwa bas mngon par zhes kyang 'don pa spo'o/ /de nas dbang bzhi pa dngos ni/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/

/byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gis gsang chen dbang gis ni/ khyod kyi sems rgyud dbang bskur ro/ / zhes brjod la rkang pa skyil krung*/ lus drang por srong*/ lta stangs g.yo ba med par byed du bcug la/ 'di skad ces/ de ltar yang rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ dngos po med la sgom pa med/ /sgom pa sgom pa nyid ma yin/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ /sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing rgyud kyi rgyal po las gsungs pa/ shes rab ye shes dag ni sems dang de'i snang ba dag kyang rnam pa bcu po nyid du 'gyur// dbang ni dri med ri bong can mtshungs me long gzugs brnyan lta bu 'di la zhugs pa gang yin pa/ /de las mya ngan 'das pa'i bde ba 'pho med lhan cig skyes pa 'gyur med nyid ni bzhi pa ste/ /sangs rgyas zhal ni gang gi thugs dang zhal la gnas par gyur pa de ni dpal ldan bla ma'o/ /zhes pa'i don chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros pa dang bral zhing*/ blo rnam par rtog pa snang ba dang bcas pa thams cad 'khrul ba'i snang ba yin par shes par byas nas/ ci yang rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang nas rnam pa thams cad pa'i mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid la mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /de las yan lag drug gi rim pas thob pa/ phyag rgya chen po dang mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes so sor rang gis rig par 'gyur ba ni/ gong ma'i gong ma chen po bzhi pa'i ye shes so/ /de ltar don dam pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du phyag rgya chen po mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i dbang bskur ba thob pas/ skye rgu'i bdag po sa bcu gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob par gyur pa yin no/ / zhes brda sprad la/ oṃ hoḥdharmā dhā tu ak+ṣa ra tsa tur+tha a bhi ṣe ke ṇa a bhi ṣik+to/ badz+ra sa twa na/ āt+ma nā haṃ/ dwī tī yo/ dwa da sha bhu mi lab+dho/ badz+ra satwa/ mahā ar+tha pa ra ma a k+ṣa raḥ

trai lo kya bi dza yaḥkā la tsakro bha ga bān/ e baṃ ka raḥ zhes rjes zlos byed du bcug pas nga rgyal bzung bar bya ste/ don dam pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shes rab ye shes dbang gong ma chen po zhes bya ba dbang bzhi pa'o/ / de nas/ dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas dang ni byang chub sems/ /dpal ldan bla ma khyed spangs nas// bla ma gzhan dag rmi lam du'ang*/ /srog dor nas ni bsten mi bya/ /gzhan yang de bzhin dus kun tu/ /g.yo sgyu med par nus tshad kyis/ /lus ngag sems dang gsum po ni/ /gtso bo'i spyan sngar dbul bar bgyi/ / zhes rjes zlos kyis dam 'cha' ru bcug gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ btang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dbul bar bya'o/ / deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyi/ khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang*/ /cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gsol/ / zhes rjes zlos lan gsum dang dge ba bsngo/ bar 'dir tshogs kyi 'khor lo'am dpa' bo'i ston mo bya/ gtor ma gsar du bsham pa'am snga ma rnams kha gsos la/ lha dgu'i sgrub thab kyi gtor chog skabs nas 'byung ba ltar/ gtor ma byin rlabs nas gzhi bdag gtor ma'i bar rnams btang la/ spyi dang mthun par rdo rje'i glu blangs pa'am/ ma blangs kyang rung ste/ steng na byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sogs shis pa brjod do/ /rjes chog gi mchod pa rnams kha gsos/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa nas/ dri ma dang bral bar gyur/ zhes byin gyis brlabs / oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥtrai dhā tu nas/ shiṣ+ya nañtsa/ zhes pas mchod yon phul/ gan+dhaṃ sogs mchod pa bcu gnyis sngags tsam gyis phul nas/ oṃ kā la tsakra sogs kyis gong bzhin nang mchod phul/ mchog sbyin rdo rje sogs rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te bstod/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/
